subject: Serious adverse event - Hepatrol - hospitalisation
body_text:
To the Pharmacovigilance Department,

I wish to report a serious adverse event.

Patient: 67-year-old male, 81 kg, no significant prior liver disease.
Product: Hepatrol 500 mg, taken orally twice daily, started 12 January 2026.

On 02 February 2026 the patient presented with jaundice, dark urine and marked fatigue. Liver function tests were significantly deranged. He was admitted to Riverside Hospital on the same day and remained an inpatient for nine days. Hepatrol was withdrawn on admission.

At the time of writing the patient is recovering but liver enzymes have not yet returned to baseline. I consider this event serious on the grounds of hospitalisation.

Dr Liang Wei, Consultant Hepatologist
Riverside Hospital, Singapore
